items.title: Statistics, standards, and training conditions to check before starting work

values: Materials and setup | All fictional, paper and pencil only

Do not use real needles, machines, glue, or customer products; experience work orders and inspection through shoe part batches and stitch spacing records. The tolerance and stop rules in the problem are practice settings only.

K1 | Work order S-42 requires 12 pairs of shoe upper parts, with 1 left piece and 1 right piece per pair; 12 left pieces and 11 right pieces arrived. Left and right pieces are not interchangeable. List the target total pieces, the total received, and the missing pieces.

K2 | The problem sets a stitch spacing target of 3.0 mm with an allowed range of 2.8 to 3.2 mm (inclusive of endpoints). The four independent records are 2.9, 3.0, 3.4, and 2.8 mm. Check the deviation and conformity of each, and do not replace per-piece judgment with an average.

K3 | Inspect 10 pieces and record that pieces 01, 03, and 07 have defects; 03 has both skipped stitches and edge line offset. Count the number of defective pieces, conforming pieces, and the ratio by unique piece number, and do not double count 03.

K4 | These 10 pieces are an independent fictional inspection group and are not mixed with the received batch count of K1. The 3 defective pieces are segregated pending verification, and no repair or release result has been given; output the work order, quantities, readings, defect status, and handoff records.

K5 | When production is about to start, the machine guard is found to be loose; this problem requires stopping work on that machine, recording the anomaly, and handing it to authorized maintenance personnel, with the authorized person deciding whether to restart after safety is confirmed. Do not touch real machines and do not instruct guard removal.
Tasks and outputs

Independently write the K1 quantity table, K2 deviation and conformity table, K3 unique piece number defect table, K4 quality handoff, and K5 machine anomaly form. Keep the original values, units, problem numbers, and unknown results.
List on-site hands-on training, craft adjustment, and quality release as items requiring separate verification.
Reference answer | Complete it independently first
K1 target 12×2=24 pieces; received 12+11=23 pieces, missing 1 right piece, and a left piece cannot substitute for a right piece.
K2 deviations −0.1, 0, +0.4, −0.2 mm; 2.9, 3.0, and 2.8 are conforming and 3.4 is nonconforming; the original 3.4 is retained, and an average cannot mask the anomaly.

K3 the unique defective pieces 01, 03, and 07 total 3 pieces; 7 pieces have none of the listed defects, and the defect rate is 3/10=30%. Do not count 4 defective pieces in total simply because piece 03 has two defects.

K4 the three defective pieces are segregated pending verification; no rework pass or release result has been given, so it cannot be called a formally conforming delivery. K5 stop that machine, record the loose guard, hand it to authorized maintenance, and await safety confirmation; do not keep rushing the work.
Boundaries and review
The 12 pairs, 24 pieces, and the independent 10-piece inspection group are recorded separately; the stitch spacing allowed range is a fictional teaching condition, not a uniform industry tolerance.
Paper calculations and the anomaly form do not prove operating, maintenance, or quality release ability. Actual procedures, safe energy control, and craft standards are confirmed by on-site training.

items.title: Education, training, and qualifications: which are the real thresholds for this occupation?

paragraphs: The Chinese 2024 shoe-making worker standard and the US BLS typical education and training are kept separate. The shoe-making standard has general education of junior high school and five skill levels, with application conditions varying by level and route; a uniform seniority promotion cannot be invented.

Paper work orders and inspection sheets only observe recording and calculation and do not prove stitching or other shoe machine operating ability; machine training, routine maintenance, troubleshooting and repair, restart, and quality release each require separate authorization checks.
Actual equipment safety follows site procedures and the applicable jurisdiction; OSHA material provides only general US risk basis and is not treated as Chinese regulations.
This page did not obtain a verifiable current single-employer case, so no uniform monthly wage, education, or experience threshold is written.

description.text: What machine operators and tenders do, how to enter, work risks, and development directions. Based on this occupation's local evidence package and official sources, retaining the statistical definitions and data gaps.

subject.name: Machine operators and tenders
subject.summary: On this page, machine operators and tenders refer specifically to the machine operation and tending of shoes and shoe parts: check materials against work orders, align components, operate joining, decorating, reinforcing, or finishing equipment, inspect finished products and stitching, record anomalies, and hand off. The work output is shoe parts meeting specifications and quality records; the frozen Chinese name does not represent all industrial machine positions.
